from pathlib import Path
import textwrap, importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != bg]
    if not colors:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    fg = max(colors, key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    masks = [[v == fg for v in row] for row in grid]
    active = [i for i, row in enumerate(masks) if any(row)]
    def rank(i):
        best = run = 0
        for x in masks[i]:
            run = run + 1 if x else 0
            best = max(best, run)
        return (best, sum(masks[i]))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in active:
        partners = [j for j in active if j != i]
        if not partners:
            continue
        j = min(partners, key=lambda j: (sum(a != b for a, b in zip(masks[i], masks[j])), -sum(a and b for a, b in zip(masks[i], masks[j]))))
        if rank(i) < rank(j):
            for x in range(w):
                if masks[j][x] and not masks[i][x]:
                    out[i][x] = 1
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-000158a3.py';p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())

def transform4(grid, threshold=.8):
 from collections import Counter
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
 colors=[v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v!=bg]
 if not colors:return [row[:] for row in grid]
 fg=max(colors,key=lambda v:sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row))
 groups=row_groups(grid,bg,fg); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 shapes=[]
 for group in groups:
  pts={(r,c) for r in group for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==fg}
  shapes.append((group[0],group[-1],pts))
 for a,(sa,ea,pa) in enumerate(shapes):
  for b,(sb,eb,pb) in enumerate(shapes):
   if len(pa)==len(pb) or ea-sa != eb-sb: continue
   if len(pa)>len(pb): src,tgt,src_top,tgt_top=pa,pb,sa,sb
   else: src,tgt,src_top,tgt_top=pb,pa,sb,sa
   if len(tgt)/len(src)<.25: continue
   dy=tgt_top-src_top
   best=None
   for dx in range(-w+1,w):
    moved={(r+dy,c+dx) for r,c in src}
    overlap=moved&tgt
    adj=sum((r,c+1) in overlap for r,c in overlap)
    key=(len(overlap),adj,-abs(dx))
    if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,dx,moved)
   if best[0][0]/len(tgt)<threshold: continue
   for r,c in best[2]:
    if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=1
 return out
for name,g,expected in [('d1',d1,d1out),('d2',d2,d2out),('d3',d3,d3out),('d4',d4,d4out),('d5',d5_correct,expected5)]:
 got=transform4(g)
 print(name,got==expected,[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if got[r][c]!=g[r][c]])
ans4=transform4(test)
print('test changes',[(r,c) for r in range(29) for c in range(24) if ans4[r][c]!=test[r][c]])
